*—What are your goals?*
Kaoru: I'd like to run the dojo in my grandfather's stead... I think.
Kaoru: I strive to be a great man who can surpass his legacy... though I know I have a long way to go, both physically and spiritually.
Kaoru: Huh? Still not spicy enough for you? Mmmm... In that case, I'd say you're asking the wrong questions.

Kaoru: The bonsai tree I inherited from my grandfather. I often lose myself just gazing at it.

*—What was your first impression of the others?*
Kaoru: Ryuusei struck me as utterly flippant at first glance, but as I quickly discovered, he's actually rather thoughtful and attentive. That said, he does have his blithe moments... but ultimately, he's more than meets the eye.
Kaoru: As for Marika... well... I find her charming, but... err... her attire makes it difficult to look at her, you know? It'd be one thing if she only dressed like that at home, but whenever we're out, I worry she draws too much attention from other men.

Kaoru: As for Marika... w-well... she might well be the sort of person I could spend the rest of my life with. She matters to me a great deal, and I intend to treat her as such.
Kaoru: The problem is, she's more than a bit... uninhibited, and... well... I'm just not used to her particular brand of openness quite yet.
*—What are your favorite and least favorite foods?*
Kaoru: I especially like Japanese cuisine, and whenever I cook, it's my go-to. My grandfather always loved Japanese food as well, so perhaps that's where I get it from.
Kaoru: That said, thanks to Ryuusei, I've been eating more Western dishes lately... though I'm not particularly good at preparing them.
*—Anything you'd like to say to our readers?*
Kaoru: I can't imagine this has been particularly entertaining for you, but... I hope you enjoyed it.
Kaoru: I get the feeling I haven't really given anyone a good sense of who I am, but at the same time, I'm not sure what else I could have said.
Kaoru: Either way, I imagine you'll learn more about me over time. Thank you for bearing with me.

Kaoru: ...Though we may hail from different worlds, I would be honored if you would still consider me your friend. And if you ever need my assistance, by all means, get in touch... I want to see you happy.

*Kaoru and Ryuusei are the first Earthlings I ever met, and they mean so much to me... I'll never forget them as long as I live, and I'll love them until the day I die.*
